_readme: Observed Payon Stories SERVER debug traces, and how our pipeline compares stage by stage.
This is the only fixture in the repo that records what the SERVER does. goldens.json
records what WE did last time, which proves we have not changed but never that we are
right. A final-number golden also cannot see two large errors that cancel - which is
exactly what the first trace below caught.
To add a trace: paste the server's debug lines verbatim into raw_log, reconstruct the
build as a scenarios.js-shaped object, then map each logged stage onto the name of our
pipeline step that should correspond. Set expect to 'match' when it should agree and
'diverges' when it is a known, explained gap - never delete a stage to make it pass.

caveats: The server logs PER HIT at the post-ratio stage (1441 x 2.77 implies a base of ~520);
stage values below are given as 3-hit totals so they are comparable with ours.
The build is reconstructed from her share link. Her exact buff state at the moment
of the log is NOT confirmed, so the divergences below bound the error rather than
pinpoint it. Confirm before treating any single stage as settled.

stages.label: post ratio (3-hit total)
stages.reason: Our base damage entering the ratio is 599 (weapon roll [183,189] + BATK 413); the server's is ~520 (1441 / 2.77). The ratio itself is right - 277% = 50 + DEX(131) + BaseLvl(96) - so the gap is upstream, in what we add to base ATK. Was 6315 (+46%) until 2026-08-28, when the ranged min-ATK scaling was gated on the arrow flag (battle.c:644 `flag&2`): Soul Bullet fires no bullet, so `atkmin = atkmin*atkmax/100` no longer applies and the weapon roll fell from a flat 347 to [183,189]. The remaining ~15% is in the status BATK / gear ATK feeding it. Moved 4976 -> 4980 on 2026-09-02 when the weapon damage roll became inclusive of weapon ATK (rnd(min, ATK) reaches ATK; it used to stop one short). That is +0.08% and takes us marginally FURTHER from the server here, which is worth noting as weak counter-evidence — but it is swamped by the ~15% upstream gap this stage already documents, so it settles nothing either way.

stages.label: post defense
stages.reason: Inherits the base-damage gap. The DEF maths itself agrees: the server applies DEF per hit then sums (1441 x 0.75 - 14) x 3 = 3202, and our single subtraction lands within 2 damage of doing it per-hit, so the ordering is cosmetic here. Moved on 2026-09-02 when the weapon damage roll became inclusive of weapon ATK (rnd(min, ATK) reaches ATK; it used to stop one short) — a ~0.1% shift, swamped by the gap this trace already documents.

stages.label: post madness (+30%)
stages.reason: Inherits the gap. The multiplier agrees exactly: 3202 -> 4162 is x1.300, and we also apply Madness Cancel as +30% at this point. Moved on 2026-09-02 when the weapon damage roll became inclusive of weapon ATK (rnd(min, ATK) reaches ATK; it used to stop one short) — a ~0.1% shift, swamped by the gap this trace already documents.

stages.label: post element fix
stages.reason: Inherits the gap. Element handling agrees: Ghost vs Ghost Lv3 = 175% on both sides (Soul Bullet is Ghost, Shade of Payon is Ghost Lv3). Moved on 2026-09-02 when the weapon damage roll became inclusive of weapon ATK (rnd(min, ATK) reaches ATK; it used to stop one short) — a ~0.1% shift, swamped by the gap this trace already documents.

stages.label: pre cardfix
stages.reason: THE IMPORTANT ONE. The server multiplies by ~1.412 between element fix and cardfix (7327 -> 10346) and we do not model that step at all - we add +90 flat for 10 coins (+1.1%). This stage used to read +4.5% while every stage above it read +46%, because our inflated base damage almost exactly cancelled the missing multiplier. With the base corrected (the ranged-scaling fix above) the two errors no longer hide each other, and the real gap shows as -17.6%. Identifying that x1.412 is the next thing to chase on this trace. Moved on 2026-09-02 when the weapon damage roll became inclusive of weapon ATK (rnd(min, ATK) reaches ATK; it used to stop one short) — a ~0.1% shift, swamped by the gap this trace already documents.
